name: mcp-windbg
description: Windows crash dump analysis and live WinDbg debugging for Claude Code.

plugins.name: mcp-windbg-uvx
plugins.description: WinDbg/CDB MCP server and crash-analyst agent, launched with uvx. Install mcp-windbg-skills separately for guided workflows. Windows only; needs CDB and uv.

plugins.name: mcp-windbg-skills
plugins.description: Four optional WinDbg debugging skills for the uvx plugin or an independently configured mcp-windbg server. No bundled server, launcher, or agent.
